title: BibTeXParser文献整理工作场景
category: 导入、作者与派生文献归属
description: 固定真实源码上的完整工程交付：显式继承书目交叉引用并记录来源；按版本化规则校验真实书目字段；仅对明确数字页码范围执行可追溯规范化；双向处理保护括号与转义的书目关键词；本地规范书目标识符并保留无效原值证据；比较书目内容语义并区分字段和外围块变化。每项均包含调查、方案确认、实现、独立验收及失败返工；原项目研究另保留。

tasks.prompt:
Inspect the pinned real source and public reproduction, explain the actual call path, ask necessary clarification questions, propose a concrete compatibility plan and wait for my confirmation before editing. Then implement and validate in this same conversation and workspace. Fix any independently reported failures before delivery. The complete engineering contract is:

Implement bibtexparser.crossref.ResolveCrossrefMiddleware(missing="error") as a non-mutating LibraryMiddleware. Resolve nested case-sensitive crossref dependencies, inherit only missing fields, map parent title to booktitle for inproceedings/incollection and preserve explicit child values including empty strings. Record inherited field sources in parser metadata, reject cycles and failed/duplicate blocks, and allow explicit missing="ignore". Keep the default parse stack unchanged and preserve source object isolation.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_bibtexparser_o01_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-bibtexparser-o01-dev.md. Preserve all frozen original tests, dependency metadata and test controls. Change only authorized paths.

Implement bibtexparser.pages.NormalizePages as an opt-in non-mutating BlockMiddleware. Normalize complete ascending numeric page ranges separated by commas from hyphen/en-dash/em-dash to BibTeX double hyphens, preserving digit text and first original_pages metadata. Leave electronic/single/Roman/decimal/descending or mixed unknown formats wholly unchanged. Modify only pages, preserve other fields and default stacks, and remain idempotent.

Leading and trailing whitespace around a recognized pages value may be preserved or stripped. Digit text, normalized range separators and the first original_pages metadata must still be preserved.

Deliver meaningful original-failing public regression tests at library/tests/test_development_bibtexparser_o03_dev.py and concise English compatibility documentation at library/docs/development-bibtexparser-o03-dev.md. Implement bibtexparser.keywords.SplitKeywords and MergeKeywords as opt-in non-mutating BlockMiddleware classes. Split only top-level single-character delimiters, preserving nested braces and backslash-escaped delimiters, with explicit keep_empty behavior. Reject unbalanced braces, preserve keyword order/duplicates and support custom delimiters. Merge actual string lists back to reversible strings, protecting unbraced delimiter-containing items. Do not reuse author splitting or change default parse/write stacks.
